audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phases[].side read Skill / Shen / Shen / Skill / Skill / Shen / Shen. The packet chart is Skill / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Skill, and the mirror audit recorded its chart as matching the packet.
audit.why: The content whys already argue the packet's version — whys[3] says Shen sustains the advantage, whys[4] says 'Level 6 does not flip the trade pattern', whys[6] says the late game is 'genuinely even'. Only the tokens were wrong, which is exactly the two-layer defect the run is hunting.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 to Shen, row 6 to Skill, as matched full+content pairs. Sylas 49.83% over 594 games fits a lane Shen edges and a late game that levels out.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why says 'Hijack online — the all-in math and every 2v2 swing your way', directly contradicting whys[4] on the same row.
audit.why: Stand United is a shield-and-teleport to an ally. Hijacking it adds nothing to a duel against a Shen who is still blocking your autos, which whys[4] states correctly.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is a macro spike, not a duel spike — and the number that makes it good is the cooldown gap: Hijack 80s at rank 1 against Stand United's 200s.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] and the mid paragraph say Spirit's Refuge has 'a short enough cooldown that he can cycle it in back-to-back trades'.
audit.why: Spirit's Refuge is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10. At the levels the claim is made about (4-5) it is 16 to 14.5 seconds — longer than Chain Lash, longer than Kingslayer, and long enough to count.
audit.corrected: It is not a back-to-back tool. Count it out and take the trade in the gap, ideally while Shadow Dash (18s at rank 1) is also down.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states what Spirit's Refuge actually blocks, so the player is told to avoid the zone entirely.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' It blocks basic attacks. Chain Lash and Kingslayer are abilities and go straight through it.
audit.corrected: The blade zone costs you Petricite Burst autos, not your spell rotation — so poke through it rather than backing off it. That reframes the whole level 2-5 stretch.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shadow Dash is called 'his taunt engage' in five fields with no range, cooldown or cost.
audit.why: 600 range, 18/16/14/12/10 cooldown, and 150 energy — a large fraction of his bar, so a whiffed dash also leaves him unable to Q immediately.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d. One whiffed Shadow Dash at rank 1 buys a full trade window.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad and dontsFull refer to losing 'no stun' with both E charges spent.
audit.why: Riot's text for Abscond/Abduct is a dash with a recast self-pull; flags list dash and projectile, no hardCC. The mirror auditor made the same call.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real risk — standing inside Shadow Dash's 600 range with nothing to leave on.

audit.why: The single suspectName, 'Use Twilight Assault' in wants.foe[1], is the correct ability name flagged on edit distance against the lowercased canonical.

edits.before: Hijack online — you now own a copy of Shen's ultimate. The all-in math and every 2v2 swing your way.
edits.after: Hijack copies Stand United at 80s against his 200s — great macro, but it wins you no duel in lane.

edits.before: Shen sustains the trade advantage through levels 4-5 as W's cooldown lets him block Petricite Burst in back-to-back skirmishes; Sylas has no burst tool to close a trade before the blade returns.
edits.after: Shen holds the trade advantage through 4-5, but Spirit's Refuge is 16s at rank 1 — it is not back-to-back, so count it out and take the trade in the gap while Shadow Dash is also down.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash (Taunt): matchup-defining — His taunt engage — punish hard while it is on cooldown. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E1 shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — 600 range, 18s at rank 1 and 150 energy, so a missed taunt is a very long invitation. - Spirit's Refuge is 16s at rank 1, not the back-to-back tool the lane feels like. - Stand United is 200s against your 80s Hijack.

edits.before: His taunt engage — punish hard while it is on cooldown. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is 600 range on an 18s rank-1 cooldown and costs 150 energy — one whiff buys you a whole trade.

edits.before: Track Shen’s Shadow Dash (Taunt): His taunt engage — punish hard while it is on cooldown. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Shen’s Spirit's Refuge: it blocks basic attacks only, so it eats Petricite Burst but never Chain Lash or Kingslayer.

edits.before: Engaging with both E charges spent — no shield, no stun, and you're a melee mage standing in the open.
edits.after: Engaging with both E charges spent — no shield, no gap-close, and you are inside Shadow Dash's 600 range.

edits.before: Both E charges spent means no shield and no exit — you're a melee mage in the open.
edits.after: A taunt forces your autos into him — Spirit's Refuge then eats them for free.

edits.before: Engaging with both E charges spent — no shield, no stun, and you're a melee mage standing in the open.
edits.after: Stand United is global and your Hijack is back in 80s — a fight bot lane is a fight you can reach.

notes: This page is the clean case of the two-layer chart defect: all seven content whys already argue the packet's chart, but three win[] tokens said something else, and phases[4].why said the opposite of whys[4] on the same row. Fixed as matched pairs. The best unstated fact: Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks, so it eats Petricite Burst but not Chain Lash or Kingslayer — the page told the player to stay out of the blade zone entirely when the correct instruction is to poke through it. Still uncorrected and worth a later sweep: the 'late' paragraph says 'your E hook-stun on a priority target', repeating the E-stun invention the mirror auditor removed from the Shen side; I could not fit a replacement inside the length band for a field that long.
